data.name: Bleakmoor House
data.detailed_description:
About This Game:

Enter the haunted, labyrinthine corridors of Bleakmoor House—where every turn leads you deeper into a twisted nightmare.

Bleakmoor House is a psychological horror experience that challenges your wits and nerves as you navigate through a maze of darkened rooms, haunting secrets, and lurking horrors. As you explore the mysterious mansion, the walls themselves seem to shift, trapping you in an ever-changing maze that plays with your mind. Uncover cryptic messages, hidden passages, and eerie sounds as you piece together the tragic history of Bleakmoor House.

With each level, the stakes rise as you uncover more about the house’s tragic past and the malevolent force that resides within. Can you find your way out before the horrors consume you?

Key Features:

  • Ever-Changing Maze: The mansion is alive, and its layout changes with every level, keeping you on edge as you attempt to navigate through shifting corridors and rooms.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in a deep and atmospheric world filled with haunting soundscapes, chilling visuals, and a pervasive sense of dread.

  • Psychological Tension: The game toys with your mind, featuring moments of intense paranoia, unexpected scares, and psychological twists that leave you questioning reality.

  • Mysteries to Unravel: Explore the dark history of Bleakmoor House, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the chilling story behind the house’s haunting past.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Solve puzzles that manipulate the environment around you, unlocking new paths and secrets as you progress through the maze-like house.

Design:

In Bleakmoor House, you’ll experience an immersive environment where every corner hides a new mystery. From the eerie creaks of the floorboards to the unsettling shadows in the corners, the design will keep you on the edge of your seat. The game’s mechanics focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival as you try to escape the ever-shifting maze. Every choice you make could be your last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or Intel Core i5-12400 or Intel Core i5-11600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 8GB or GeForce GTX 1660 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7600 or Intel Core i5-13400 or Intel Core i5-12600K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
